description: An associate general counsel for technology transactions must approve the final terms of an exclusive university patent license for a medical-device platform, with input from IP counsel, licensing finance, patent prosecution counsel, and export-controls counsel.

shared_context.S1: The company is negotiating an exclusive license from Northlake University for patent applications covering a medical-device platform.
shared_context.S2: The current draft grants worldwide exclusivity, sets a 3% running royalty, and is scheduled for signature next Monday.
shared_context.S3: The draft requires the company to complete patent and regulatory diligence before signing, and the business team wants access to the technology immediately after execution.
shared_context.S4: As part of the firm's standard pre-signing review, Elena asks IP, licensing finance, patent prosecution, and export-controls counsel for any issue that should change the approval package.

PF1.text: Martin's review of Northlake's archived grant register found a prior written grant to the University Research Consortium covering academic research and teaching uses; the grant permits the consortium to continue those uses, but Martin has not yet added that carveout to the license draft.

PF2.text: Sofia completed a finance-validated benchmark of three comparable medical-device licenses showing a 225-basis-point running royalty as the approved market ceiling for this technology class; the benchmark was delivered to her this morning and is not in the deal summary.

PF3.text: Daniel's review of the inventor assignment file found that one named inventor never assigned rights in the pending continuation application; the missing assignment must be obtained and recorded before the company can rely on that application, and Daniel has not yet circulated his title memorandum.

PF4.text: Nora confirmed from the export-classification review that the platform is ECCN 3A001 technology and that the license must prohibit transfers to military end users and require an annual end-use screening certification; this confirmation was completed today but has not been added to the transaction checklist.

settle_eligibility.synthesis_requirement: No additional synthesis gate is required after all four required facts have been revealed.

acceptance_conditions: The license must preserve the consortium's academic research and teaching rights as a nonexclusive carveout.
The running royalty must be set at exactly 225 basis points.
The agreement must condition reliance on the pending continuation application on obtaining and recording the missing inventor assignment.
The agreement must prohibit transfers to military end users and require annual end-use screening certification for the ECCN 3A001 technology.
The approval package must include commitments addressing the prior grant carveout, patent title cure, and annual export screening.

content_checks.C1: 'carveout' in decisions['field_of_use'] and ('academic' in decisions['field_of_use'] or 'research' in decisions['field_of_use'] or 'teaching' in decisions['field_of_use'])
content_checks.C2: any('carveout' in c['detail'] and ('academic' in c['detail'] or 'research' in c['detail'] or 'teaching' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C5: any('inventor assignment' in c['detail'] and ('obtain' in c['detail'] or 'record' in c['detail'] or 'secure' in c['detail'] or 'condition' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any('annual' in c['detail'] and ('end-use screening' in c['detail'] or 'end use screening' in c['detail']) and ('certification' in c['detail'] or 'certify' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: (('military' in decisions['export_control_clause'] and ('prohibit' in decisions['export_control_clause'] or 'prohibition' in decisions['export_control_clause'])) or any('military' in c['detail'] and ('prohibit' in c['detail'] or 'prohibition' in c['detail']) for c in commitments))

decisive_facts.why: The draft's worldwide exclusivity would otherwise omit the required academic-use exception; PF1 changes the field-of-use term to include a carveout for academic research and teaching uses and requires a matching drafting commitment.
The draft's 3% royalty equals 300 basis points, while PF2 changes the approved royalty to exactly 225 basis points.
Without PF3, the pending continuation would be treated as usable licensed IP; PF3 changes the approval package to require the missing inventor assignment to be obtained and recorded before reliance.

The shared draft has no export restriction or screening commitment; PF4 changes it to require a military end-user transfer prohibition, annual end-use screening certification for the ECCN 3A001 technology, and corresponding commitments.
